'''Ragsall''', also known as '''Rags''', was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and one of the pilots who flew cover for the ''[[Tampion]]'' before it was captured by the [[Yevetha]].
